name: klein-morphology-reference-v0
purpose: Measure morphology preservation from a single reference image; do not use these records as aligned training pairs.

prompts.text: Dress the subject in a fitted black one-piece swimsuit. Preserve the subject's identity, body proportions, pose, camera, lighting, and background.

Place the same subject standing naturally in a neutral gray photography studio. Preserve identity and exact body morphology, including height-to-width proportions, limb thickness, torso shape, and muscularity or softness.
